children: The U.S. Energy Information Administration on Monday said it was delaying the release of its Petroleum Supply Monthly data for June 2026, which was set to come out on August 31, following an operational issue.
The data will be released in September, the EIA said, without providing a specific date.
The EIA said the issue was related to how its back-end and public-facing systems interact.
